title: Why 3 BHK Homes Are Becoming the Preferred Choice for Modern Families
snippet: This blog explains why 3 bhk homes are increasingly becoming the preferred choice for growing families in India. It explores how larger layouts support privacy, future-readiness, and everyday convenience through multi use rooms, a functional multi use bedroom, and practical multi use living room ideas, making them better suited to modern family living.

title: Why 3 BHK Homes Are Becoming a Preferred Choice for Modern Families
snippet: As lifestyles evolve and families look for spaces that can adapt to their changing needs, 3 BHK homes are increasingly becoming a preferred choice for modern homebuyers.

title: 3BHK Homes Lead Buyer Preferences: Anarock Survey 2026 - Outlook Money
snippet: The 3BHK units have emerged as the most preferred configuration, with homes that are priced between Rs 90 lakh and Rs 1.50 crore being the preferred choice, according to data shared in Anarock's H1 2026 Homebuyer Sentiment Survey. The survey was conducted between January and June 2026, and covered nearly 8,320 respondents across 14 cities.

title: 2 BHK vs 3 BHK in 2026: What Indian Homebuyers Prefer & Why
snippet: Indian homebuyers in 2026 are becoming more aspirational, lifestyle-focused, and future-oriented. 2 BHK homes remain the backbone of affordability-driven markets, especially in peripheral and mid-income locations. But across major metros, rising incomes, hybrid work, and premiumisation are clearly pushing demand toward 3 BHK homes.

title: Why 3 Bhk Homes Are Becoming the Preferred Choice for Modern Buyers?
snippet: Driven by changing lifestyles and growing expectations, larger homes are now seen as a practical and future-ready investment.
